data.physical_FINAL_limit: WOOD training includes sibling images from REC_001/REC_002 also represented in protected physical FINAL. Exact229 protected images/frame identities are excluded, but recording-independent physical-FINAL evaluation cannot be claimed.
data.supplied_metadata: Pallet type, registered dimensions and per-record native K are provided. No real keypoint/pose annotation coordinates supervise selection or training.
data.calibration_status: Source-provided K; WOOD is explicitly PROVIDED_UNVERIFIED. No measured/independently verified calibration claim.

stages: Add reflect100 border to native BGR uint8 image.
Resize padded canvas back to original native W,H using cv2.INTER_LINEAR with uint8 intermediate rounding.
Resize preserving native aspect ratio to shortest side400; actual dimensions are rounded then floored to multiples of8.
Normalize ImageNet RGB mean/std, final tensor FP32.
preprocessing.native_K_policy: Decode predictions by inverse exact affine into original pixels before PnP, RANSAC, LOO, flip errors and native bounds. Native K is used directly; resized coordinates are never paired with unscaled native K.

decoder.confidence_definition: Per-channel raw belief maximum, not calibrated probability
decoder.smoothed_peak_detection: scipy Gaussian sigma2, local maxima and smoothed response>0.3

filter.geometry_units: metres for registered3D cuboids; native pixels for2D
filter.registered_cuboid: C2 camera-facing corner order; x/z front-depth swap hypotheses for rectangular PLASTIC and WOOD; one hypothesis for square GREEN.
filter.original_usable: Finite decoded original point inside native image, valid decoder flag and original confidence>=0.3.
filter.PnP: EPnP then solvePnPRefineLM on exactly the selected fitting indices; zero-distortion pinhole; all projected corners positive depth>1e-6.
filter.RANSAC: 50 deterministic5-corner draws; error<5 native pixels; at least6 inliers. Prefer most inliers, smallest median reprojection error, then smallest mean; refine consensus once, allowing no newly added inliers.
filter.normalization_D: Maximum pairwise Euclidean distance among the eight consensus-pose projected corners, not axis-aligned bounding-box diagonal.
filter.LOO: For each selected RANSAC inlier, fit on all other selected inliers (at least5), excluding the held-out corner from both EPnP and LM; compare held-out prediction with its reprojection. LOO is conditional on the initial RANSAC-selected consensus.
filter.LOO_frame_condition: median normalized LOO error over the consensus <0.05

main_flip.usable: Both restored views valid, finite, inside native bounds and confidence>=0.3

ablation.R1_cache: Only original9-field R0 predictions imported from prior paired-view inference; geometry/pose/RANSAC/LOO/acceptance/masks recomputed. R1 raw original predictions remain identical across treatments.
ablation.R2_teacher_forward: Own R1 model, original image only, batch1.

filter.final_acceptance: At least6 corners individually survive all enabled checks and frame medians. Centroid channel8 is never trusted for real loss. Geometry is self-consistency, not proof of GT correctness.

training.initialization: Every kind and the shared synthetic-only control starts from the exact same original R0; no other kind or mixed-trained weights initialize an arm.
training.round_teacher: R1=R0; R2=that kind own fixed R1. Pseudo-labels generated once at the start of each round; no EMA teacher.
training.optimizer_state: Adam and GradScaler preserved between rounds; final Adam/scaler counters1656.
training.batch: Synthetic batch8, all400x528; real batch<=8 homogeneous-shape buckets, short batches preserved. Accepted real set repeats as needed; repeated augmentation is not new independent data.
training.synthetic_sampler_seed: seed42 + round_index*1000000 + zero_based_epoch*1000; private sampler RNG independent of real augmentation. All7 optimization arms share the same6epoch synthetic schedule.

numerics.nonfinite_policy: Fail and record; do not count a skipped optimizer update.

augmentation.applies_to: Real pseudo branch only; photometric, no geometric target-coordinate change

training.checkpoint_policy: Report both fixed R1 and R2 final checkpoints; no best epoch/round, threshold or model selected from evaluation outcomes.
training.controlled_comparison_limit: Equal optimizer and synthetic budgets do not imply equal accepted-real sample counts or exposures. Main PLASTIC R1 uses one unique accepted real image.

targets_and_loss.belief: Full-grid sigma2 Gaussian centred at affine(native)/8-0.4395; only map boundary clips tails. This corrects the canonical decoder offset and avoids asymmetric2sigma support truncation.
targets_and_loss.spatial_mask: Finite transformed point centre inside belief map. Real supervision additionally intersects trusted native-bound corner mask; missing/untrusted/out-of-map channels have zero loss weight rather than all-zero negative targets.
targets_and_loss.synthetic_affinity: Six-stage16-channel unit vectors from each corner to centroid on radius1 belief-grid support; physical corner coordinates receive no belief-offset shift; invalid corner/centroid pairs ignored.
targets_and_loss.reduction: For each branch/head, sum squared error over effective-batch valid channels and all spatial pixels divided by valid-channel-count*H*W. No affinity supervision on real images.
targets_and_loss.target_limitation: Finite decoder11x11 window leaves a small subpixel residual; outer prepared-canvas boundary has unavoidable inward bias. Unit-test native640x480 interior/native-edge fixture max roundtrip error0.367px; no universal exact inversion claim.

evaluation.inference: Frozen FP32, batch1, no autocast, TF32False, canonical prepare/decode; missing semantic corners preserved.
evaluation.semantic_matching: Same semantic corner index0..7; centroid excluded; no GT-based rematching or symmetry reorder.
evaluation.eligible_references: Finite annotation corner0..7, geometric native in-frame and annotated in_frame=True, visibility1/2 (>0).
evaluation.PCK10: Count(error<=10 original-image pixels) / all eligible reference corners; missing predictions fail. Not ten percent of object size.
evaluation.conditional_median: Median pixel error only over observed predictions; cannot summarize missing predictions alone.
evaluation.manual_reference_panel: GREEN600 explicitly manual-click references is auxiliary and does not replace primary943 references.
evaluation.interpretation_limit: Single seed, repeatedly reused DEV, mixed unknown/PnP references; no independent TEST, causal population-wide guarantee, or physical6D pose-accuracy claim.
